newsitem.title: USA: Sierra, Physician Corp to merge.
newsitem.headline: Sierra, Physician Corp to merge.

text.p: Sierra Health Services Inc and Physician Corp of America said on Monday they would merge to become the nation's eighth-largest publicly traded managed care company with $2 billion in revenue.
The merger, expected to close by March 31 1997, is pending normal shareholder and regulatory approvals, it said.
The deal would be accounted for as a tax-free pooling of interests, with each Physician Corp of America share being exchanged for 0.45 share of Sierra Health Services.

Physicians Corp of America said it expects to repay a $118.5 million bank loan when the merger closes. The company said it is continuing to discuss financial covenants and repayment terms terms for the loan with its bankers.
On Monday Physicians Corp reported that third quarter losses after a one-time $2.11 charge had widened to $2.44 per share from the year-ago $0.03.
Physicians Corp said its membership rose 30 percent from the year-ago period, to 948,000 members.
The combined company would serve nearly 1.5 million people in 18 states and Puerto Rico. It would be named Sierra Health Services Inc and would have its headquarters in Las Vegas.

"This merger represents an excellent strategic opportunity for Sierra to gain a strong multi-state presence," said Anthony Marlon, Sierra's chairman and chief executive officer. "We will be able to substantially broaden our existing service area in Texas, and become one of the market leaders in Florida and Puerto Rico."
